scope_note: Exactly the 19 authenticated compiler/toolchain/CMake/Ninja archive inputs consumed by the frozen native build. All are external build components. Original notices are byte-preserved, and custom references retain aggregate or vendor-only declarations without inventing grants. These tools are not runtime files and are not distributed with the product. Runtime static GCC/MinGW selected members have a separate exact link-map review. This document does not claim every source file in these vendor archives was compiled or every vendor-declared optional package was consumed.
dependency_resolution_note: Edges preserve exact .PKGINFO dependencies among selected inputs. The GCC cc-libs metapackage name is resolved to the selected libgcc and libstdc++ split runtime inputs. Unselected vendor-declared packages remain explicit metadata rather than fictitious input components.
